title: rotate executor
description: Creates a fresh Nx Cloud organization + workspace via the create-org-and-workspace API and rebinds this workspace by writing the returned nxCloudId into nx.json. Deleting the old organization is a manual step (no public API exists).

workspaceName.description: Name sent to create-org-and-workspace. Default: root package.json `name`.

cloudUrl.description: Nx Cloud instance URL. Default: NX_CLOUD_API/NRWL_API env or https://cloud.nx.app.

installationSource.description: installationSource tag sent with the request.

dryRun.description: Call the API but do not rewrite nx.json.
